Due to impassable terrain, no direct route exists between Zone Alpha and Zone Beta.
Furthermore, due to logistical and permitting restrictions, the final inspection circuit must incorporate exactly one of the following two critical transit corridors: the route between Zone Beta and Zone Gamma, or the route between Zone Gamma and Zone Delta.

The objective is to determine the minimal total travel distance for a closed inspection loop that visits every zone precisely once before returning to the point of origin.
